verdict.rationale: AvaTax computes jurisdiction-aware tax, tracks nexus, and supports 200+ countries, which feeds correct tax data into invoicing systems, but the evidence pack shows no explicit invoice-document generation with mandated VAT fields (VAT ID display, invoice sequencing, locale-specific legal text) — it's tax calculation/reporting API, not an invoicing engine itself. missing for 10: evidence of actual invoice template/field generation (VAT registration number printing, locale-specific invoice legal requirements), and independent/hands-on confirmation that generated data satisfies specific country e-invoicing mandates.
